title: U.S. passport renewal - basics
facts: Eligible applicants may renew a U.S. passport using the State Department renewal process rather than a first-time DS-11 application.
Eligibility depends on factors including the prior passport, age when it was issued, how long ago it was issued, condition, and name-change documentation.
Some eligible adults can renew online; others use Form DS-82 by mail.
A person who does not meet renewal requirements generally applies in person using Form DS-11.
